source_text: Virgae duodecim tribuum in tabernaculo ponuntur; virga Aaron germina germinavit et flores produxit et amygdalas. Virga de radice Iesse flosque Christi praefiguratur. Sacerdotium verum in Christo floret. Cui gloria in saecula. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Rods of-twelve tribes in tabernacle are-placed; rod of-Aaron sprouts sprouted and flowers produced and almonds. Rod from root of-Jesse and-flower of-Christ is-prefigured. Priesthood true in Christ flowers. To-whom glory into ages. Amen.
pass_b_english: The twelve rods are set in the tent; Aaron’s rod put forth buds, flowers, and almonds. It prefigures the [[rod from the root of Jesse and the flower of Christ >> Bible:Isaiah 11:1]]. True priesthood blossoms in Christ. To whom be glory forever. Amen.
